claims.statement: UNESCO places Sammallahdenmäki in the Scandinavian Bronze Age context of approximately 1500–500 BCE.
Communities built granite burial cairns in clusters along a ridge in western Finland.
The map uses UNESCO’s reference position for Sammallahdenmäki’s burial cairns, not a territorial boundary.

evidence.locator: Brief synthesis, first two paragraphs; site coordinate listing
evidence.note: This is a Bronze Age context band, not the full lifespan of the cemetery. UNESCO also records two excavated cairns from the Early Iron Age. The site marker is not a cultural boundary.
